text:
zoe.marketing: First full draft of the launch blog posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-v1. Asks: tighten hero claim, surface benchmark stat near top, confirm webinar CTA and registration tiers + UTM. Quick eyes by 3pm PT please.

mike.prod: Skimmedlooks good. Suggest hero: 'can reduce per-token inference cost by up to ~40% for common batch/latency profiles' (if legal ok). Also call benchmarks 'real app traces'.

tara.content: Agree move a one-line benchmark snapshot under the hero. Keep bullets concise. Add a line that registering routes leads to Sales.
\zolivia.legal: Quick pass: use 'can reduce' and 'up to'. Add footnote: '*Benchmarks run on Redwood internal workloads; results vary by model, seq length, and batch size. See appendix for methodology and dates.' Add short privacy note near form.

james.growth: UTMs: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2. Add hidden form field 'launch_interest' and select: [Attend live, Watch recording, Case-study/pilot]. I'll map to HubSpot.

maria.design: I'll make a small stats card under hero. Need exact CTA text and 2-line 'what you'll learn'.

zoe.marketing: Draft CTA: 'Register: Live launch walkthrough + cost playbook'
What you'll learn:
- Unit-cost levers and benchmark context
- Deployment checklist for Dedicated & Private
- Live demo + Q&A
Link locked to /events/launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2
Privacy note: 'By registering you consent to contact from Redwood; data stored in HubSpot per our privacy policy.'

mike.prod: In appendix include model family, seq lengths, batch sizes, hardware, and Optimize toggles (caching/quant).

olivia.legal: Approved with footnote and privacy note.

tara.content: Approved. Minor edits done.

maria.design: Approved on layout; assets by EOD tomorrow.

james.growth: +1 on UTMs and fields. Will start HubSpot mapping after publish lock.

deploy-bot: Note: publish window opens in 36 hours. Final approvals due by 3pm PT to hit slot.

zoe.marketing: Thanks team ":tada:" locking content and kicking design + HubSpot handoff.
